# Test fixtures

## cube_lifting_real/

Three real successful trials of the baseline collection (task cube_lifting, seeds 302, 306, 307; CaP-X copy
vendored in NVlabs/ASPIRE, Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, multi-turn with visual differencing and parallel ensemble). Copied
read-only from the collection run; videos and images were not copied.

| file | origin |
| --- | --- |
| `trials/.../trial_*/all_responses.json`, `summary.txt`, `code.py`, `differencing_feedback_*.txt` | the trial folders as CaP-X wrote them, byte-identical |
| `cube_lifting.yaml` | the resolved config that run used, as the collection runner wrote it (perception ports moved to 5811x, two `resume_idx` lines) |
| `sources.yaml` | input of `convert rows` for these trials |
| `expected_rows.jsonl` | rows written by the original conversion script that produced the baseline training data, run on these three trials with run tag `fixture`; only `metadata.source` was renamed to `capx_multiturn` |

No absolute paths or user names appear in these files (checked before committing).
